title: alchemilla sericata subsp. rigida
intro: Alchemilla sericata subsp. rigida, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, as it has been traditionally used to treat menstrual disorders and promote wound healing. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to regulate menstrual cycles, reduce inflammation, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for these therapeutic actions include flavonoids, tannins, and rosmarinic acid, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
